Fury4047777 5 years ago #5 11 in total. Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney (the very first game in the series) PW:AA Justice for All (second) PW:AA Trials and Tribulations (third game) Apollo Justice (fourth) Dual Destinies (fifth) Spirit of Justice (sixth and last currently in the mainline series) Ace Attorney Investigations (the edgeworth game you heard of) Investigations 2 (sequel to the game above, only in Japan right now) The two great ace attorney games obviously And finally, there's a crossover game of Ace Attorney and Professor Layton.
